name: bge-small-rrf-lme-v1
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (config.json max_position_embeddings 512). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. A finetune of BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 on LongMemEval question/gold-session pairs. Same 33.4M parameters and 384 dims as the base - the 0.033 vs 0.0334 difference is safetensors float rounding, not a size change. Recorded because the card prints a vanilla-BGE row and this row in both its NDCG@10 and Recall@K tables. All headline numbers rest on a 102-query holdout scored through the author's own vstash hybrid pipeline. Licence mit, repo created 2026-02-19.

benchmarks.name: LongMemEval-s NDCG@10
benchmarks.config: Card 'NDCG@10 on the holdout' table, rows 'BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (vanilla)' 0.6143 vs this model 0.6878 (x100). 102-query disjoint holdout, seed-42 80/20 stratified split, scored through the author's own vstash hybrid pipeline (RRF + adaptive IDF + MMR dedup).

benchmarks.name: LongMemEval-s Recall@3
benchmarks.config: Same card 'Recall@K' table, base BGE 0.8418 vs 0.8716; paired bootstrap B=1000 95% CI [+0.0085,+0.0529], significant.

benchmarks.name: LongMemEval-s Recall@5
benchmarks.config: Same table, base 0.8905, CI [+0.0172,+0.0619], significant. R@1 (0.5552 vs 0.5209) and R@10 (0.9658 vs 0.9634) also higher but the card marks their CIs as crossing zero / saturated, so they are not recorded.
